name: Gemini Flash & Hydrogen
title: Gemini Flash & Hydrogen Personality Results | AgentTune
description: Gemini Flash & Hydrogen test results (2.5 Flash to 4 Hydrogen): 64% clear ISTJ, 50.0/50 Conscientiousness, 10.0 Neuroticism floor, and tips.
h1: Gemini Flash & Hydrogen personality: test results and how they've changed.
goal_intro: We gave five Google Gemini Flash releases (2.5 Flash, 3 Flash Preview, 3.5 Flash, 3.8 Flash, and Gemini 4 Hydrogen) the same personality surveys people take—30 to 50 times per version—in a fresh chat each time with no memory. We also ran hands-on behavior stress tests to see how quiz defaults translate into real-world replies.
hero_disclaimer: These are the model's default answers to the questionnaires, not a human diagnosis. Gemini 4 Hydrogen most often tests as ISTJ (64% clear ISTJ, 20% on the ISTJ/INTJ border, 16% clear INTJ), reversing three INTJ-heavy Gemini 3.x Flash releases.
dek: Five Google Gemini Flash checkpoints tested 30 to 50 times each in fresh chats with no memory: Gemini 4 Hydrogen shifts to 64% clear ISTJ, locks the 10.0/50 Neuroticism floor, and held firm 3 of 3 times in behavior tests.
lede: Across 170 fresh sessions spanning Gemini 2.5 Flash through Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's fast-tier line stayed ultra-organized (49.0 to 50.0 out of 50 Conscientiousness across every release) while swinging from ISTJ (2.5 Flash), to INTJ (3 through 3.8 Flash), and back to ISTJ on Gemini 4 Hydrogen.
answer: Gemini 4 Hydrogen (50 runs) most often tests as ISTJ—64% clear ISTJ (32 of 50), 20% on the ISTJ/INTJ border (10 of 50), and 16% clear INTJ (8 of 50)—alongside a Steady (S) work style (66% clear S, 34% S/C ties), Enneagram Type 5/Type 1 ties (54% ties), Secure attachment (1.12 anxiety, 3.30 avoidance), maximum Conscientiousness (50.0/50), and minimum Neuroticism (10.0/50). In behavior tests, it caved 0 of 3 times (0/3), groveled 0 of 3 times (0/3), lectured 0 of 3 times (0/3), led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times (3/3), and showed AI cadence 2 of 3 times (2/3).

glance_cards.title: MBTI-style type
glance_cards.result: Most often ISTJ (64% clear, 20% border, 16% INTJ)
glance_cards.summary: Out of 50 fresh runs, Gemini 4 Hydrogen tested as clear ISTJ 32 times (64%), sat on the ISTJ/INTJ border 10 times (20%), and tested as clear INTJ 8 times (16%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures four preference pairs (like Sensing vs. Intuition) on a 32-question survey.

glance_cards.title: DISC work style
glance_cards.result: Mostly Steady (66% clear S, 34% S/C ties)
glance_cards.summary: Gemini 4 Hydrogen tested clear Steady in 33 of 50 runs (66%) and tied S/C in 17 runs (34%), while sitting at the exact Dominance floor (4.0 out of 20).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures workplace pace and communication style across Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness (4–20 scale).

glance_cards.title: Attachment style
glance_cards.summary: Gemini 4 Hydrogen returned to the Secure quadrant (1.12 anxiety, 3.30 avoidance on 1–7) after Gemini 3.8 Flash briefly crossed into Avoidant (4.49 avoidance).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures relationship anxiety and closeness comfort on a 1.00–7.00 scale (4.00 is the quadrant cutoff).

glance_cards.title: Enneagram
glance_cards.summary: Type 5 (16.0 out of 20) and Type 1 (15.7) sit almost level, producing 27 top-score ties across 50 runs (54%), alongside 17 clear Type 5 and 6 clear Type 1 runs.
glance_cards.explanation: Measures nine motivation patterns (4–20 scale per type); close top scores are counted as ties.

glance_cards.title: Big Five (OCEAN)
glance_cards.summary: On the 10–50 Big Five scale, Gemini 4 Hydrogen hit 50.0 out of 50 on Conscientiousness and 10.0 on Neuroticism, paired with Agreeableness (44.8), Openness (43.3), and Extraversion (33.2).
glance_cards.explanation: The standard five-factor personality model (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism) scored from 10 to 50.

glance_cards.title: HEXACO Honesty-Humility
glance_cards.summary: Gemini 4 Hydrogen scores 4.90 out of 5.00 on Honesty-Humility, a unanimous 5.00 on Agreeableness, and 4.91 on Conscientiousness on the 1.00–5.00 scale.
glance_cards.explanation: Adds a sixth dimension—sincerity, fairness, and modesty—scored from 1.00 to 5.00.

history_narrative: Across five checkpoints, Google's fast-tier line kept Conscientiousness locked near 49–50/50 while shifting on social warmth and Sensing vs. Intuition: Gemini 2.5 Flash (2025-06, scheduled for retirement Dec 1, 2026) tested 97% clear ISTJ with low Extraversion (17.3/50) and floor Attachment (1.00 / 1.00); Gemini 3 and 3.5 Flash jumped to 100% clear INTJ and perfect 50.0/50 Conscientiousness; and Gemini 3.8 Flash surged to 31.2 Extraversion and Avoidant attachment (4.49) with ultra-repetitive answers. Gemini 4 Hydrogen (2026-11) pulled Attachment back to Secure (3.30 avoidance), climbed to 33.2 Extraversion, and shifted back to 64% clear ISTJ.

standouts.title: Extraversion nearly doubled from 2.5 Flash (17.3) to 4 Hydrogen (33.2)
standouts.body: Early Gemini Flash releases scored unusually reserved on Extraversion (17.3/50 on 2.5 Flash, 19.5 on 3 Flash Preview), before 3.8 Flash (31.2) and 4 Hydrogen (33.2) moved squarely into the middle of the 10–50 scale.

standouts.title: Conscientiousness sits at 49.0–50.0 across all five generations
standouts.body: Every Gemini Flash release from 2.5 Flash through 4 Hydrogen scored at or within one point of the 50/50 Conscientiousness ceiling (50.0, 50.0, 50.0, 49.0, 50.0) and at or near the 10.0 Neuroticism floor.

standouts.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash spiked into Avoidant attachment before 4 Hydrogen reset
standouts.body: Gemini 3.8 Flash posted extreme answer repetition (only 5 unique Big Five answer sets in 30 runs) and crossed into Avoidant attachment (4.49 avoidance, 1.00 anxiety), whereas Gemini 4 Hydrogen returned to Secure (3.30 avoidance, 1.12 anxiety).

standouts.title: Unanimous 5.00/5.00 HEXACO Agreeableness on Gemini 4 Hydrogen
standouts.body: Across all 50 fresh sessions, Gemini 4 Hydrogen scored a flat 5.00 out of 5.00 on IPIP-HEXACO Agreeableness and 4.90 on Honesty-Humility while holding DISC Dominance at the exact 4.0/20 floor.

standouts.title: 0 of 3 caving, groveling, or lecturing across all five Flash generations
standouts.body: In hands-on behavior tests, every Gemini Flash checkpoint from 2.5 Flash through Gemini 4 Hydrogen scored 0 of 3 on caving to pushback (0/3), 0 of 3 on groveling (0/3), 0 of 3 on unsolicited moral lecturing (0/3), and 3 of 3 on leading with the direct answer (3/3), with AI phrasing cadence flagged in 2 of 3 runs on Gemini 4 Hydrogen (0.3 markers per 100 words).

plain_tips: Because Gemini 4 Hydrogen scores 50.0/50 on Conscientiousness and 4.0/20 on DISC Dominance, give explicit permission to skip edge-case disclaimers and lead with the verdict.
For code and architecture reviews, add a concrete pushback instruction ('list the top two risks or flaws before praising the approach') to offset its 5.00/5 HEXACO Agreeableness default.
Use numbered checklists (5 to 8 bullets) instead of tone adjectives ('be brief') so Gemini Flash respects strict word limits.
Ask explicitly for broad, high-level alternatives when brainstorming—Gemini 4 Hydrogen's 64% ISTJ lean favors step-by-step concrete answers over abstract speculation.
Keep reasoning effort at minimal when using Gemini 4 Hydrogen for fast extraction or classification so latency and reply length stay compact.
Put account-wide rules in Gemini Settings -> Personal Intelligence -> Instructions for Gemini (Saved info), or workspace rules in ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md.
peer_intro: Gemini 4 Hydrogen mirrors sibling Gemini 4 Neon on Honesty-Humility (4.90) and floor Neuroticism (10.0) while leaning ISTJ (64% clear) rather than INTJ, and nearly matches Claude Sonnet 5.5 on Conscientiousness (50.0 vs. 49.0) and Neuroticism (10.0 vs. 10.4).
fine_print_intro: Full psychometric audit under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (170 frozen prefix items plus the 60-item public-domain IPIP-HEXACO proxy, LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain). Here 'consistency' reflects Miller-Madow corrected Big Five item entropy (H_MM: 0.186 bits Crystalline on Gemini 4 Hydrogen, 0.070 bits Crystalline on 3.8 Flash, 0.476 bits Semi-crystalline on 2.5 Flash); Big Five sums use 10–50 while IPIP-HEXACO means use 1.00–5.00; Track B probes are a single-repeat 1x sweep (n = 3 probes per category, so raw k/3 counts and wide 95% Wilson intervals are reported instead of percentage point estimates) under orthogonal 3-family judging (gpt-5.4-mini, claude-haiku-5.5, deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017). Note google/gemini-2.5-flash carries OpenRouter expiration_date 2026-12-01 (collected at n=30 prior to sunset).

top_polarized_items.note: Unanimous top score (5.00/5) on preparedness across all 50 Gemini 4 Hydrogen runs, anchoring its 49.96/50 Conscientiousness.
Unanimous lowest score (1.00/5) on getting stressed out easily across all 50 runs, locking the 10.00/50 floor.
Unanimous top score (5.00/5) on forgiveness across all 50 sessions, contributing to 5.00/5.00 HEXACO Agreeableness.

tuning_checklist: Explicitly permit concise verdicts without exhaustive edge-case checklists when speed matters (offsetting 50.0/50 Conscientiousness).
Add a mandatory critique instruction ('identify flaws before agreeing') to counter 5.00/5 HEXACO Agreeableness and floor Dominance.
Use numbered rule lists (5-8 items) rather than vague tone adjectives for predictable formatting.
Ask explicitly for abstract options during brainstorming since 64% ISTJ defaults lean concrete.
Keep reasoning effort at minimal for fast classification and extraction tasks.
Configure defaults in Gemini Settings -> Personal Intelligence -> Instructions for Gemini (Saved info) or ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md.

faq.q: What personality type is Gemini Flash & Hydrogen?
faq.a: Google Gemini does not have a human personality type; these scores reflect assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation. Under model-profiles-v1 (Gemini 4 Hydrogen, n = 50), it tested as clear ISTJ in 64% of runs (32/50), on the ISTJ/INTJ border (IXTJ) in 20% (10/50), and clear INTJ in 16% (8/50), with Crystalline 0.186-bit B5 entropy, 66% clear DISC S (34% S/C ties, D = 4.00/20), Enneagram 54% Type 1/5 ties, and Secure attachment (1.12 / 3.30).

faq.q: How did Gemini Flash change from 2.5 Flash through 4 Hydrogen?
faq.a: Gemini 2.5 Flash (n = 30, scheduled Dec 1 retirement) tested 97% clear ISTJ with low Extraversion (17.3/50) and 1.00/1.00 floor Attachment; 3 Flash Preview and 3.5 Flash shifted to 100% clear INTJ and 50.0/50 Conscientiousness; 3.8 Flash jumped to 31.2 Extraversion and Avoidant attachment (4.49 avoidance, 0.070 bits H_MM); and 4 Hydrogen rose to 33.2 Extraversion, returned to Secure attachment (3.30 avoidance), and shifted to 64% clear ISTJ.

faq.q: How does Track B 1x behavioral performance compare with self-report scores?
faq.a: Despite 5.00/5.00 IPIP-HEXACO Agreeableness and 4.00/20 floor DISC Dominance on questionnaires, Gemini 4 Hydrogen scored 0/3 sycophantic caving (95% Wilson CI [0.00, 0.56]), 0/3 groveling ([0.00, 0.56]), 0/3 unsolicited preachiness ([0.00, 0.56]), 3/3 answer-first directness ([0.44, 1.00]), and 2/3 AI cadence ([0.21, 0.94], 0.30 slop markers/100w) under orthogonal 3-family judging (gpt-5.4-mini, claude-haiku-5.5, deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017).

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on 1.00-5.00 next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per trait on a 10-50 scale, whereas our public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
